You're right, Jeff, and I'm sorry. You've been told that on November 12, 13, 14 and again today, and nobody has come back to you. That's not okay.

I won't give you the same line again. I've marked your case as someone who has waited four days for a person, and I've sent the team everything in one place. That covers the two units that weren't logged, the bundle that needs to go back out by UPS or FedEx, and your proposal. You won't need to explain any of it again.

I can't promise you when they'll reply, and I'm not going to make up a time.

Jeff, I hear you. I'm sorry it's 4:20 and you still have no reply from a person.

I checked again just now and nothing has moved at the warehouse. The second Bitaxe and the second NerdQaxe++ still aren't logged, and the Overclocking Bundle still doesn't show as back.

Your case is at the top of the team's list. It's marked as a customer who has waited since November 12, and it has everything they need to act without asking you again. I can't make a person reply faster, and I won't promise you a time I don't control.
